# Inno Setup language resource

`ChineseSimplified.isl` contains the unchanged upstream text (with normalized
line endings) from the official
[`jrsoftware/issrc`](https://github.com/jrsoftware/issrc) repository at commit
`6ef32198ef1f7b7b375cd4b6b90896c2a58eb4c2`.

Its upstream maintainer and encoding information remain in the file header.
The applicable Inno Setup license is included alongside it in `LICENSE.txt`.
